evidence_class: Static: reviewed only the frozen expected-red Stage1 test module and frozen controls plan; no Rust command, candidate body, prototype, reference, or physical replay was run
Ran: independent two-dimensional IEEE-754 binary64 arithmetic only, using the authority-prescribed product/add/divide/negate grouping

findings.finding: The analytic helper contract is ambiguous and exposes expected/alternate arithmetic. With h interpreted as the authority's complete shifted defect, h=[-2,0], lambda=1, q=[1,0] cannot produce asserted zero; with h interpreted as the unshifted gradient it produces [-1,0], not zero. Fields h0_bits_expected, h1_bits_expected, ordinary_defect_without_lambda_q, delta_with_transposed_v, delta_in_ascending_order, and certificate_* invite the calculation/accessor to manufacture expected answers or duplicate prohibited arithmetic.
findings.required_change: Define the analytic input as an unshifted defect g=B^T(f+A*p), set g=[-1,0], lambda=1, q=[1,0], and assert the one actual shared shifted-defect result is [0,0]. Keep all expected and deliberately-wrong values test-side. Remove every *_expected/certificate output and every alternate-calculation output. The runtime helper may expose actual operands, actual intermediates, actual results, and counters only; it must enter the same shared product/sum/shift/inverse operations as the body and must not form B^T B. Retained-certificate comparison must continue to load the external certificate in the test and pass only the captured input to the calculation. Remove the redundant zero-argument retained helper or make it accept the capture without loading expected data.

findings.finding: The nonsymmetric oracle has free-slot and coordinate order reversed and its first rational expression is not bit-identical to the required grouped binary64 calculation. The input also omits factor.order, so it cannot prove traversal through a non-default order.

independent_oracle.input_semantics: V rows are free slots [coordinate 1, coordinate 0]; h is in those free slots; raw spectral columns are 0,1
independent_oracle.note: The test's [110/63,-10/21] is coordinate order, not free-slot order; the expression -10.0/21.0 has bits bfde79e79e79e79e and therefore cannot be used for exact equality to the grouped result bfde79e79e79e7a2.

findings.required_change: Assert test-side u64 bit literals for actual t, z, and delta in free-slot order. Assert the coordinate join separately at coordinates [1,0]. Add factor.order to the analytic input and exercise a non-default order with operands whose binary64 accumulation changes when traversed in raw order, so the test distinguishes factor.order from 0..m. Do not return a transposed-V or ascending-order counterfactual from the helper.

findings.finding: P1ReducedNormNonfinite and P2ReducedNormNonfinite are unreachable through the required guard order when the full and reduced norms inspect the same actual vector: a nonfinite free coordinate is already rejected by the preceding full norm. An enum-to-error poison helper could therefore become the invented error factory prohibited by the authority.
findings.required_change: Delete those two nonfinite reduced-norm cases. Replace them with reachable finite reduced-radius violations: use unequal original and remaining radii and a finite p1/p2 whose full norm is at most original_radius while its recomputed free norm exceeds remaining_radius; assert ScratchRadius/ScratchReducedRadius/First and FinalRadius/FinalReducedRadius/Second. Retain separate actual full-norm nonfinite cases. Every poison helper must mutate a documented real operand at the named seam and then invoke the shared guard path; record the mutated operand bits and reached operation/stage, and prohibit enum-to-error matching. Add actual denominator overflow/nonfinite and division underflow or nonfinite inverse/update operands through the shared arithmetic, because the required finite positive lambda makes a mathematical zero denominator unavailable.

findings.finding: Passing both reservations one below their bounds cannot discriminate scalar-cap ownership from guard-cap ownership, and literal zero hook assertions can pass without observing operations. The exact-cap admission boundary is also absent.
findings.required_change: Use three cases: scalar=70275 with guard capacity sufficient; guard=211235 with scalar capacity sufficient; and exact scalar=70276/guard=211236 admitted through branch entry. For every denial assert before/after deltas from the real monotonic ledger and hook snapshots: attempted and owning denied counter each +1, executed scalar/guard/factor/Dot2 deltas zero, phase/evaluator/hydraulic/materialization deltas zero, and owner/budget snapshots unchanged. Do not assert globally initialized literal zeros. The admitted boundary must observe actual category entry without requiring a physical replay.

findings.finding: Boolean fields box_feasible/full_ball_feasible/reduced_ball_feasible/radius_gap_within_tolerance can self-certify the implementation and do not prove the prescribed recomputation/order.
findings.required_change: Expose only actual p vectors, masks, original/remaining radii, ordered full/reduced norm bits, gap/tolerance operand bits, reached guard stages, and operation counters. Compare them in tests to external certificate values or independent test-side literals. Preserve the existing captured-face test as the primary external-certificate control.

residual_risk_and_missing_tests: No candidate body exists, so shared-operation reachability, absence of duplicate accessor math, exact guard precedence, and actual counter deltas remain future source-review obligations.

The current controls still need distinct reachable p1/p2 box, full-radius, reduced-radius, closeness, source-domain, denominator, division/inverse-output, update, and no-third-correction cases routed through shared body operations.
Signed -0.0 must enter the pre-existing BVLS-03 function and compare its actual result/counters with the unchanged BVLS-03 control; a helper-selected string alone is insufficient.
approval: No prospective control approval. Resolve C04-CONTROL-001 through C04-CONTROL-004 before authorizing body work; C04-CONTROL-005 must be resolved before controls can qualify green evidence.
